info.name: HR SaaS API
info.description:
All API requests for the HR SaaS platform. Import into Postman or use with Newman.

**Setup:** Import `hr-saas.local.postman_environment.json` or set collection variables `baseUrl`, `accessToken`, and `pendingTenantId`.

**Auth flow:** Register submits for approval (no token). Super admin approves, then company admin logs in. Login saves `accessToken` automatically.
